raw.rationale: Desoximetasone is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist with cytostatic/cytotoxic activity mainly in lymphoid malignancies; among the listed lineages, glucocorticoid receptor expression and dependency are strongest in breast and some CNS and skin contexts, but PRISM single-dose screens typically show no lineage-selective killing for this class at 2.5 µM. Therefore probabilities remain near the low base rate for all listed lineages.
